scope: Source inspection plus executed small-scale acceptance; a found implementation is not a complete paper-campaign reproduction.

status_definitions.FOUND_VERIFIED_SMALL: Actual retained code executed on declared small inputs, including synthetic or real-prefix data.
status_definitions.FOUND_VERIFIED_IDENTITY: Retained artifacts checked against original hashes or bytes.
status_definitions.FOUND_EXTERNAL_REQUIRED: Implementation found; full execution additionally requires external inputs/deployment.
status_definitions.MISSING_HISTORICAL_RESOURCE: No matching redistributable historical artifact/download was established. No substitute is fabricated.
